technique: CG-rendered 3D animation with a felted/wool-fiber surface shader applied to skin and clothing to mimic stop-motion claymation (visible fiber nap and directional texture on the man's face/suit and the woman's sweater, plus fine felted grain on hair). Best read as 3D CG built to evoke a stop-motion look (Aardman-style character design: elongated wedge noses, oversized flat eyes, wiry felted hair) rather than genuine frame-by-frame puppet photography.

overall_animation_style_notes: Visual formula is a two-character static-camera kitchen dialogue scene: caricatured Aardman-esque puppet character design (huge wedge noses, small sunken eyes, visible felt/fiber texture) rendered in clean CG rather than shot as physical stop-motion, paired with bold flat-colored title-card typography ('BLAME IT ON AI', 'Episode 18', 'LOW BATTERY PEOPLE') burned over the live-action-paced footage.
